obs: "It must not be understood that every law which imposes a penalty is, therefore, legally speaking, a penal law, that is, a law which is to be construed with great strictness in favour of the defendant."
"the statute under which this action is brought is remedial and not penal"
Bramwell v. United States Fidelity & Guaranty Co.
"As this statute has reference to the public good it ought to be liberally construed."
